then.text: I heard you took the hamper to the peat bank and fought the Camp Manager himself! I don't believe a word of it, but it's a good story, and I'll say so at the Globe.

Hamper's with you, I think? Take it out to Camp, to the peat cutters at the banks, west of the track. Then find the farm. And show the Camp Manager a Johnny Rook if you can catch one. It'll make his day.

else.text: Smoko. That's the word for the break in the morning, about eleven, when you stop everything and have tea and cake. If you are going to Camp, take a hamper. Would you take one to the peat cutters? I'll never get there with the shop to mind.

fal_pilot.text: RAF Mount Pleasant is about thirty-five miles west of here. The Airbridge from Brize Norton takes about eighteen hours with a stop at Ascension, and I do the lot in a mood.
Stanley's lovely. You come in off the plane and it's like arriving in a very windy village that has been told it's a capital.

fal_birder.text: Gypsy Cove, a few miles east. Magellanic penguins, in burrows, braying like donkeys. You'll hear them before you see them. They stand at the entrance and give you a look.
Jackass penguins, we call them. Because of the noise. It's affectionate. Or it was in my family.

fal_wreckwatcher.text: That's the Lady Elizabeth, out there. She came in for repairs in 1913 and was never repaired. She is a hulk now, a floating warehouse that stopped floating. I'm told she's the best-preserved old sailing ship in the world, which is not a high bar.
At low tide you can walk to some of them. Don't. The mud has been waiting a long time.

fal_kid.text: Everyone knows everyone here. I know the Governor's dog, the vicar's cat and the name of every sheep on Dairy Paddock. If someone moves in I know their bus route by the end of the week.
When the weather's bad the whole school stops and we look at the sky. We've a name for each sort of wind. The name for the worst is not in the dictionary.

falklands_stanley_return.text: The Mount Pleasant bus leaves from here, and takes about an hour and a bit. The plane takes a long time to get home. I can book you on the next flight. It's the Airbridge: one stop, Ascension, and a lot of tea.
